name: Git Plugin
description: Full Git management plugin (~1000 lines). Shows remotes list, local and remote branches with checkout capability and current branch indicator, commit log (50 commits, clickable to view diff), staged and unstaged file lists with expand/collapse and stage/unstage buttons, commit input bar with commit button, push button with ahead-behind indicator. Diff viewer: unified and side-by-side modes with syntax-colored lines (green for additions, red for deletions). File tree for commit diffs, commit info panel (hash, author, date, message). Resizable split layout (left 260px for tree/branches/changes, right with vertical split for diff viewer). Auto-refresh on file changes via fs:onChanged. Single-instance enforcement (canvas prevents duplicate git plugins).

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Serialize selected commit hash, file path, diff view mode, and splitter sizes

methods.name: applyLayout
methods.description: Immediately apply saved splitter sizes without async delay

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restore view state and splitter sizes from saved session

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reload all git data: remotes, branches, commits, staged/unstaged files

properties.name: onFileOpen
properties.description: Called to open a file from git in an editor

features.branches: List local and remote branches, current branch highlighted, click to checkout
features.commit_log: 50 commits with hash, author, date, message — click to view diff tree
features.staged_files: List staged files with expand/collapse, diff view, unstage button
features.unstaged_files: List unstaged files with expand/collapse, diff view, stage button
features.commit_bar: Text input + Commit button, keyboard Enter to commit
features.push: Push button with ahead-behind indicator via git:checkAhead
features.diff_viewer: Unified and side-by-side modes, green/red line coloring, per-commit per-file diffs
features.file_tree: Collapsible tree of changed files per commit with status indicators (A/M/D/R/C)
features.commit_info: Panel showing commit hash, author, date, full commit body
features.split_layout: Left: tree/branches/changes (260px default, resizable 120-600px). Right: diff viewer with vertical split (top file tree 150px default, resizable min 40px). Sizes persisted in GitState
features.auto_refresh: Re-fetches git state when files change (debounced)
